selection: H45 changes only completion-time evidence retention. Earlier Round 26 and 27 identities remain immutable and excluded.
treatment: After the exact shared prefix, both arms receive no repeated task-state projection. At finalization only treatment receives a bounded receipt-bound closure over delivered base observations overlapping actual changed ranges, and those IDs are deterministically unioned into the validated final selection.

branch_order.method: predeclared alternating schedule over task index plus repetition; no outcome input

stopping_rules: Any prefix that terminates before its first recycle is retained as instrument-ineligible and is not replaced.
Any snapshot, ancestry, common-policy, receipt or pre-treatment identity mismatch stops that task before branch dispatch.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, state content, repetition count, order, replacement, or lucky rerun.
Record every prefix and branch model input/output token; unknown usage makes the pair ineligible.
claim_ceiling: Exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K causal development study; no untouched confirmation, larger-window, repair-correctness, transfer, or ContextBench clearance claim.
